name: Elite Material
summary: Elite Material Co., Ltd., established in 1992 and headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan, is an international manufacturer and supplier with operations spanning Taiwan, China, and other global markets. The company primarily produces and sells critical electronic materials and components, including copper clad laminates, specialized electronic-industrial chemicals and raw materials, printed circuit boards (PCBs), and prepreg. Beyond its core manufacturing, Elite Material diversifies its business by engaging in the wholesale and retail of electronics, telecommunications equipment, and batteries. Their activities also extend to power generation and distribution, machinery production, and import/export trade. The firm's advanced products are integral to a broad spectrum of industries, such as mobile devices, automotive and infrastructure, aerospace, industrial, and military applications.
